L='tup';S='tupp';M=65536
def G(g,x):
    t=x^((x<<1)|(x<<2));return t if g=='t' else t^1 if g=='u' else t^1^(2 if x%2==0 else 0)
def A(x):return G('t',x)>>2
def omega(q,g):return int((q%16==0 and g=='t') or (q%16==1 and g=='u'))
def gate(q):return 'u' if q%16==7 else 't' if q%16==11 else None
def F(q):return G(gate(q),G('p',q>>2))
def admissible(w):return not any(b in w for b in ['uu','ttttt','ututtu'])
def cost(q,g):return omega(A(q),S[G(g,q)%4])
def wordstate(a,word):
    assert word[0]==a;x=3 if a=='p' else 1;pref=[x];counts=[0]*48
    for g in word[1:]:counts[3*(x%16)+L.index(g)]+=1;x=G(g,x);pref.append(x)
    return x,pref,counts
def H(a,w):
    _,pref,_=wordstate(a,w);return a+''.join(S[x%4] for x in pref[1:])

for g in data['phase_graphs']:

    assert len(nodes)==g['visited_count'] and sha(canon(nodes))==g['visited_discovery_sha256']
    assert sha(canon(sorted(n[0] for n in nodes)))==g['visited_sorted_residues_sha256']
    seen={root:0};cursor=0;allow=deny=0
    for ix,(src,mask) in enumerate(g['processed_rows']):
        assert src==ix and 0<mask<=7
        for gi in range(mask.bit_length()):
            assert mask&(1<<gi)
            row=g['attempted_edges'][cursor];cursor+=1
            q=nodes[src][0];y=G(L[gi],q)%M;c=cost(q,L[gi]);assert row[:4]==[src,gi,y,c]
            if c:

            else:

                assert row[4:]==[seen[y],fresh]

    assert cursor==len(g['attempted_edges'])==g['all_attempted_edges_cell_checked']
    assert len(seen)==len(nodes) and allow==g['allowed_edges'] and deny==g['forbidden_edges']
    path=g['target_path_node_indices'];assert path[0]==0 and nodes[path[-1]][0]==65019
